programme.desc: Jerry and Tuffy discover Ginger's surprise for Rick in the garage: a brand-new air hockey table. They enjoy floating in zero gravity before Tom comes in and stops the fun. Soon, Butch challenges Tom to a game, until they start chasing Tuffy into the house and out back.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Tom and Jerry break a picture frame on the wall, Rick gives Tom an ultimatum that he's out for good if he breaks one more thing. Despite Tom's earnest response, he breaks something right after Rick leaves to purchase a new frame. Attempting to fix the problem, Tom borrows tools and coveralls from a repair truck nearby but can't stop breaking things in the repair process.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Jerry overhears that a brand-new butler will arrive at the household later that day, the crafty mouse whips together a butler's outfit and knocks on the door, pretending to be the new arrival—to get unbridled access to the pantry. How long will Jerry's disguise work, and what happens when the real butler arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: After (accidentally) rescuing a kitten from a tree Mr. Bean is set to have his picture in the newspaper! The photographer arrives with the grateful lady cat owner, the scene is set, smiles all round…but then disaster strikes when Bean is continually upstaged by… his hair.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is serving food at a diner. Jerry and Tuffy sneak in and eat the food. Tom tries to chase them out of the diner and in the end they all share a delicious treat.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: To ease the burden on MOE, the Batwheels use his duplicating machine to make copies of their repair bot, but the Batcave is soon overrun when the machine breaks!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: The Batcave's cutest resident bat Alfie sneaks into Bam the Batmobile and causes adorable chaos during a mission to stop the Ducky Boat down at Gotham Docks.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne brings the gang to Ireland to visit an ancient Blake family castle. As the gang becomes enchanted by the magical Emerald Isle, an angry, rampaging Giant makes them reconsider just how wonderful all the old myths and legends really are.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang visits a farm that's being haunted by a creepy Scarecrow Ghost. Fred wants to impress the farmer's daughter with his mystery-solving skills, but for some reason, this case just isn't adding up.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A container adrift along the icefield will change the lives of Grizzy and the Lemmings: it’s an inexhaustible stock of chocolate spread! There is so much, that for the first time the close enemies have no need to fight over the treat. They entice a flock of penguins into hoisting the container out of the water. One of the penguins, who did not get his reward in fish, is disgruntled. Grizzy has him taste the Yummy, then throws the jar far away to get rid of the penguin. The chocolate treat spreads over the icefield. Fatal error?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy uses a fire extinguisher to chase the Lemmings from the living room so that he can take a nap, but the gadget accidentally flies out the window. It lands at the top of an ice cliff, causing a fissure, and the peak of the cliff topples. Amid the debris, the Lemmings discover a fearsome creature: the Yeti, who is looking for the guilty party. The Lemmings bring him to Grizzy, never dreaming that the giant will immediately fall in love with the Ranger’s cabin and throw a very original party.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are bored. A coconut rolls over to Grizzy’s feet, pulling the bear out of his state of torpor. He imagines a sort of face on the nut and decides to care for it, like a child with its doll. He has so much fun playing with his new toy that the Lemmings want to join in. But when the bear refuses, the Lemmings ruse: they hide inside other coconuts in hopes of being adopted by Grizzy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is persuaded that he's discovered the ultimate gadget for good living: a pair of connected glasses for watching TV in panoramic view, with all sorts of indicators, namely an intrusion warning signal. There is only one real drawback: the speedometer function which the Lemmings adore.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings clamor for their turn to play with the ranger's mobile phone, but Grizzy isn't in the sharing mood. And he's very talented at flattening anything that comes near, without looking up from his game. The Lemmings invent an implacable protection system which should enable them to recover the mobile in complete safety.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is captivated by a mime artist on TV who makes viewers believe in the presence of an invisible wall. To get rid of the Lemmings, who have sights on his jar of Yummy, Grizzy hides the jar and pretends he has an invisible one. When the Lemmings see through the trick, they decide to trap Grizzy with a grand illusion number.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Dino Ranchers race to track down a high-pitched squeak. What they find is a baby Ankylosaurus, squeaking in panic as a pack of Raptors circles in for the attack! Springing into action, the team drives off the raptors and rescues the frightened little dino! Unbeknown to the Ranchers, the raptors follow them back to the Dino HQ, and they must know protect the baby dino once again

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The volcano on Dino Island is ready to blow! The Ranchers' mission: rescue a cluster of dino eggs too close to the volcano's fiery base before the heat turns their nests into ash! The operation hits a snag when a frantic Plesiosaur needs help! Jon frees the panicked creature, and the two become fast friends! He names her Noodles, and she's eager to help, maybe a little too eager!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is obsessed by his favourite TV hero ‘Super Spy’ and is excited when his very own Super-Spy spy kit arrives in the post. While Mr Bean is pretending to be his favourite character and delighting in all his gadgets he spots some unusual goings on in the Bruisers’ house next door. Naturally Mr Bean assumes the worst and sets out to rectify the situation.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean inadvertently causes an accident which prevents Irma taking the scout troop to Big Bear’s Scout Camp. With the scout master and mini bus out of action Mr Bean steps in to save the day. As temporary scoutmaster Mr Bean enjoys his new role but his obsessive badge collecting wins him no friends within the group.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean cannot find anywhere to park other than the space he spots in a school’s car park. There’s a case of mistaken identity and Mr Bean finds himself teaching a class of unruly school kids. Bean uses every trick in the book to win them over and ends up teaching the headmaster how to be a success in school.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst trying to redecorate the hall, Bean is obstructed at every turn by his landlady’s vile one-eyed cat. Bean pops it in the dustbin to keep it out of the way for a while. Just his luck that it’s rubbish collection day.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover a hollow branch filled with sap. When they blow into it, it makes bubbles! They have fun chasing and popping them. Baby Owl marvels at a few bubbles that have strayed near her nest and takes it upon herself to guide them out of the forest so that they can fly away without bursting. When she discovers the Baby Lemmings' game of popping as many bubbles as possible, she decides to put an end to it.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover they can play spinning top with nuts. Baby Lynx sets out to beat the lemmings at their game by making herself a big spinning top that can destroy the lemmings' spinning tops. The defeated baby lemmings then find a huge stone top, but just as they're about to play with it, Baby Lynx returns and challenges their mega top.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Raccoon notices that the forest floor is covered in leaves... No way! It's too dirty for him. He decides to rake them up into nice, cubic heaps, not realizing that he's providing great cushions for the baby lemmings, who have fun throwing themselves into them making firework displays of colorful leaves! Faced with this rampage, Baby Raccoon decides to block the baby lemmings and resume his housework, but the little baby lemmings have more than one trick up their sleeve!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs' slumber is interrupted when his ears decide it's time to go dancing.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks square off as street musicians.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs is tricked into Elmer Fudd's new Petting Zoo but Bugs is quick to make his escape.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs' vacation to Hawaii is frozen over when The Winter Stag shows up with the same idea. Is the vacation of a lifetime hot or cold?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: In the season two premiere episode, the gang forces an over-worked Fred to relax and take time off from mysteries at Daphne's family's beach house. Unfortunately, when a walking shark attacks the ritzy beach community, the gang is forced to solve the mystery without Fred finding out about it.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang rushes Scooby to an animal hospital when he suddenly falls ill. But things go from bad to worse when they discover the Gothic, old hospital is also home to a rampaging werewolf!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms. Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is very scared on a stormy night and even more so when he hears Mrs Wicket screaming from downstairs. Mr Bean investigates and finds the source of the problem...a rat! Mr Bean offers to help Mrs Wicket rid their house of the troublesome rodent. The only problem is the crafty rat is going nowhere fast and is always one step ahead. Mr Bean looks to inspiration from the Pied Piper but fairy stories don’t always have happy endings.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Ginger and Rick's vegetable garden is growing, and they need a way to keep out the gophers. Ginger says traps are cruel, but Tom can handle the task! However, things start getting out of hand when a lady gopher falls in love with Jerry, and the two plan a garden raid together.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Skullie tells Tom that he won't have to sweat a visit from one of the spooks tonight. However, Tom is soon drawn to a full-length mirror that causes no shortage of trouble. As he gets pulled into the mirror, an evil reflection cat trades places with him. Tuffy and Jerry enter the mirror world too and must fight their reflection selves for survival.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Stinker, the trash-loving dog, comes by looking for help, Tom and Jerry aren't inclined to take the case until they hear it involves a missing fortune. So, they're disappointed when they find out Stinker is searching for a lost fortune cookie from his Chinese takeout to learn his fate. Retracing the dog's steps, they chase the fortune cookie's trail through town.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The vibrations created by Grizzy's snoring during his nap give the Lemmings an idea for a bouncing game. But when Grizzy changes positions and his snoring stops, the Lemmings must find other sources of vibrations. Only these are no longer compatible with Grizzy's nap.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a birthday piñata in the ranger's living room. The idea of bursting open a papier-mâché statue with a bat like it says in the instructions pleases him. The Lemmings, who prefer to use it as a toy to swing from, are determined to stop Grizzy from destroying the piñata.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Inside a mysterious cave, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a magical Game of the Goose. The events displayed in the squares that the players land on come true in real life. When Grizzy and the Lemmings realize, it's too late to stop the game.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is bothered by an object stuck in between the sofa cushions: a big fur lemming puppet glove. He puts his hand inside and has fun pretending that the puppet is strangling him. The Lemmings believe that the puppet is a Super Lemming who's stronger than Grizzy and start to obey it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the leftovers of a Halloween party in the ranger's cabin, which was entirely redecorated for the occasion, with stupefaction. But if the curious ambiance perturbs Grizzy, the Lemmings are in seventh heaven and have a whale of a time jumping up and down inside a cooking pot full of marshmallows. Grizzy wants to get rid of it until he accidentally swallows a marshmallow and discovers the best flavor of his life.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to give the she-bear he's in love with a plastic ring which he finds really swell. But since the object was found in the trash, he needs to wash it first. And the Lemmings are using the sole bar of soap in the house as a bobsleigh.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: The Kazoom Kid Heroes and the Kazoom Kid Villains face off to gain control of the city's energy.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Clayface is back in town, and this time he may be too much, and too many, for the Batwheels to handle!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After snagging an ultra-fuel-cell upgrade, Penguin’s Ducky Boat suddenly becomes the fastest vehicle in Gotham. Confident leader Bam must rally the Batwheels to stop the turbo-Ducky!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Buff befriends Mr. Freeze’s snowcrawler Snowy, the other Batwheels bristle at the thought of hanging out with a “bad guy…” so Buff sets out to change their minds.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After he causes the Batwing to crash, Bam becomes obsessed with making it up to her during a high-stakes aerial mission against Penguin and his giant ducky blimp.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired to build a festive course for the Fall foot race. Wile E. Coyote is determined to beat the Road Runner with his Robo-Runner despite its malfunctions.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Curt Cuckoo hires The Looney Builders to build a giant cuckoo clock in Germany to signal the start of Martinstag. The crew struggles to get it right until they ask Curt for his help.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired to build a surfside hangout in Australia for a surfing competition. Bugs and Daffy want to compete but are a little out of their league until Taz offers to teach them.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Giovanna Badgerini to update her family’s pizzeria in Italy. However, Giovanna’s Mamma prefers the old way of doing things, which causes setbacks with the build until the crew helps them compromise.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Porky Pig uses his steamroller to flatten and make sure every build is “Porky Perfect” in this music video.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean accidently causes Mrs Wicket to be hospitalised and in need of a wheelchair. Back home Mr Bean has thoughtfully set up a bell service so that he can be at Mrs Wicket’s beck and call at any time of day or night. Mrs Wicket likes this...a lot. The bell doesn’t stop ringing and an exhausted Mr Bean finds himself running up and down the stairs carrying and fetching until he eventually loses patience with his patient.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s car has broken down and he is late to meet Irma for a night at the opera. Mr Bean finally arrives but he is refused entry to the theatre because of his filthy attire. Forced to borrow some clothes from the local launderette Bean is mistaken for the star of the show and ends up on the stage giving the operatic performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken – not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: A gust of wind sweeps away the flower that Grizzy's adored she-bear wears in her hair. Grizzy sees this as a golden opportunity to dazzle her by bringing it back. But the Lemmings, who are riding on the back of a bucking caribou, realize that the flower makes their mount sneeze, which only makes the game ten times more fun!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds two identical vases that are actually communicating vessels in a Native American Indian chest. If he sticks his hand in one, it comes out the other, between them. This should satisfy Grizzy's natural lazy streak, regardless of the distance unless the Lemmings realize the incredible games they could play with the magic vases.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets you wind back the minute that has just passed by and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings. This will give him a sure advantage over the Lemmings, provided of course they don't get their hands on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed in the middle of his TV snack by a strange flow of incongruous objects that have been transformed into hot-air balloons. When he sees the Lemmings onboard these curious zeppelins, Grizzy understands that he will quickly have to confiscate their helium tank and balloons if he wants to relax in front of the TV.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers with great delight that the ranger has purchased a brand new multifunction Stressless recliner. But even an armchair designed for well-being - the ultimate in relaxation - can used for other purposes by the Lemmings, who transform it into a fearsome multi-game chair.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings play kite-surf with a homemade kite. Grizzy notices that the she-bear he's in love with watches the kite perform arabesques in the sky with admiration. He decides to make a kite that is far more sophisticated than the Lemmings kite.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy snatches the last jar of chocolate spread out from under the noses of the Lemmings. In exchange, he offers them the toy stuck inside the lid: a mini-flute. When the Lemmings blow into the flute, the shrill notes that come out paralyze anyone whose ears aren't plugged for several seconds. They decide to play a tune for Grizzy in order to recover their share of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings play a new game, floating like flags in the breeze from the fan which is set at maximum. Grizzy, who has decided to watch his favorite TV documentary on salmon fish, quickly rids the living room of this interference. But he didn't anticipate that the Lemmings would continue their game on the roof with the wind pump and TV antenna, and that the interference would reappear... inside the TV!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a grand old time tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy remarks that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the Lemmings' construction and makes believe that it's his work of art. But when the building collapses yet again, the she-bear walks off. Grizzy decides to build an even bigger one.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two. When Grizzy tries to stop them, they go on to the next lesson and get him in a judo hold. Grizzy understands that he needs the book so that he too can become a pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams that he's a valiant knight who has just delivered his beloved. As he is about to take her in his arms, he is woken by the din of the Lemmings, who have chosen this particular day to blast music. Grizzy has only one desire: pick up his dream where he left off. But first, he'll have to stop the Lemmings' fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy stands in front of the pantry, desperate. The stock of chocolate spread is completely depleted. He realizes that the Lemmings are making some themselves, following a complicated recipe. If they can make it, then why can’t he?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine with a jewelry ad showing a man offering a diamond to a woman, Grizzy imagines himself offering the ranger's engagement ring to his beloved she-bear. But the big diamond set in the ring has disappeared. The Lemmings, who are having a spinning-top contest, are using it as the ultimate top. And they have no intention of giving it up.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When he accidentally sticks a computer microprocessor to his temple, Grizzy is transformed into an exceptionally intelligent being capable of predicting events to come far in advance. With his way above average IQ, not only will he be able to provide himself with the latest high-tech comfort, getting rid of the Lemmings should be a piece of cake.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings prepare a dream afternoon snack with the last jar of chocolate spread in the cupboard. Tough luck, Grizzy is coming! Caught off guard, the Lemmings hide the jar in a teddy bear-pajama case to slip away without arousing suspicion. But Grizzy is captivated by the stuffed bear and makes it his security blanket.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Mr Bean is taking Irma to a cheap restaurant with a two-for-one deal on. But due to a mix up with the taxis they end up in a posh restaurant that Mr Paliwal had booked, and the Paliwals end up in the budget café where Mr Bean was meant to be. How long will it take for Mr Bean to realise he’s in the wrong place, and will he admit it to Irma when he does?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is far from thrilled to be going on a country walk with Irma to see an ancient ruin, especially when he sees a pair of ramblers with all the latest hiking kit. But instead of taking up their offer of help, he gets extremely competitive and is desperate to beat them to the stone circle, even when Irma gets fed up and joins her new hiking friends.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bam can't wait to recharge after a long night of heroism in Gotham, but first, the Batwheels need all kinds of help, delaying his much-needed nap just a little bit longer...

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Moley and Dotty spot Old Coot sneaking around MoleTown, Dotty can’t resist following. Soon they discover his secret tunnel, but all is not what it seems.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When a mysterious sighting breeds rumors of aliens in Mole Town, Moley and Dotty investigate in hopes of finding the truth.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When everything seems to be going wrong for Dotty, she takes Manny out on an adventure and runs into the Gardener, who plots to steal him!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Tom and Jerry - Season 1

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: When Chanterelle comes across something Mush-Mush has made, she declares him a genius artist! But Mush-Mush is not sure that’s the kind of genius he wants to be.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: At midnight, a gothic lady cat appears with her favorite sinister plant creatures including her personal favorite: Fang, a big man-eating plant. As long as it's sealed in the hothouse, nothing can go wrong. But Tom, Jerry and Tuffy soon have their hands full with the escaped plant.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Cates appears and assigns Tom the job of sweeping the estate's chimneys, warning him not to upset the Duchess's new exotic pet bird. Unfortunately, both the pet bird and a stork at the top of the chimney think Jerry is a worm. Soon chaos breaks out, hurting Tom's cleaning efforts.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Tom finds out he won a contest to be in a cat food commercial, his behavior turns smug. This irritates Jerry, who goes to great lengths to ruin the commercial shoot at the house as Tom struggles in his role.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Peter, a pretentious cheapskate poodle, demands that Tom and Jerry help protect his precious sapphire egg on a train journey but won't pay their fare. The cat and mouse become stowaways and go to a lot of trouble to do their job, but the outcome is unexpected.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Dino Ranchers race to track down a high-pitched squeak. What they find is a baby Ankylosaurus, squeaking in panic as a pack of Raptors circles in for the attack! Springing into action, the team drives off the raptors and rescues the frightened little dino! Unbeknown to the Ranchers, the raptors follow them back to the Dino HQ, and they must know protect the baby dino once again

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The volcano on Dino Island is ready to blow! The Ranchers' mission: rescue a cluster of dino eggs too close to the volcano's fiery base before the heat turns their nests into ash! The operation hits a snag when a frantic Plesiosaur needs help! Jon frees the panicked creature, and the two become fast friends! He names her Noodles, and she's eager to help, maybe a little too eager!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms. Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1

Shaggy puts aside his cowardly ways to save his home team. But will Scooby stand by his (now not-so-scared) pal?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The Gang has seats on the largest airplane ever to fly the open airways! Unfortunately, the plane is also beset by a Gremlin bent on sabotaging the flight! The Gang has to step up to solve the airborne mystery as well as deal with something even scarier: Daphne in the pilot seat!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds two identical vases that are actually communicating vessels in a Native American Indian chest. If he sticks his hand in one, it comes out the other, between them. This should satisfy Grizzy's natural lazy streak, regardless of the distance unless the Lemmings realize the incredible games they could play with the magic vases.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a vintage stopwatch in the garage which lets you wind back the minute that has just passed by and it can even stop time and movement in one's surroundings. This will give him a sure advantage over the Lemmings, provided of course they don't get their hands on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed in the middle of his TV snack by a strange flow of incongruous objects that have been transformed into hot-air balloons. When he sees the Lemmings onboard these curious zeppelins, Grizzy understands that he will quickly have to confiscate their helium tank and balloons if he wants to relax in front of the TV.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers with great delight that the ranger has purchased a brand new multifunction Stressless recliner. But even an armchair designed for well-being - the ultimate in relaxation - can used for other purposes by the Lemmings, who transform it into a fearsome multi-game chair.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings play kite-surf with a homemade kite. Grizzy notices that the she-bear he's in love with watches the kite perform arabesques in the sky with admiration. He decides to make a kite that is far more sophisticated than the Lemmings kite.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy snatches the last jar of chocolate spread out from under the noses of the Lemmings. In exchange, he offers them the toy stuck inside the lid: a mini-flute. When the Lemmings blow into the flute, the shrill notes that come out paralyze anyone whose ears aren't plugged for several seconds. They decide to play a tune for Grizzy in order to recover their share of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings play a new game, floating like flags in the breeze from the fan which is set at maximum. Grizzy, who has decided to watch his favorite TV documentary on salmon fish, quickly rids the living room of this interference. But he didn't anticipate that the Lemmings would continue their game on the roof with the wind pump and TV antenna, and that the interference would reappear... inside the TV!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a grand old time tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy remarks that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the Lemmings' construction and makes believe that it's his work of art. But when the building collapses yet again, the she-bear walks off. Grizzy decides to build an even bigger one.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two. When Grizzy tries to stop them, they go on to the next lesson and get him in a judo hold. Grizzy understands that he needs the book so that he too can become a pro.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Kept awake by Tom watching TV, Jerry goes outside and encounters some lightning bugs. The smallest one can't keep up, so Jerry steals Tom's energy drink for the little guy. It helps, but soon the super-charged bug causes unexpected issues for Tom and Jerry.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Skullie warns Tom that it's almost midnight, so he'd best be on alert for one of the Catsylvania ghouls to show up. Tom reaches for a towel to wipe the soap out of his eyes but is shocked to discover that he's not using a towel at all, but a Mummy-cat's wrap! Soon, the Mummy-cat finds ways to freak out Tom and befuddle him, Jerry and Tuffy all over the house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Hoping to woo Toodles, Tom decides to make some homemade perfume for her. He throws in many unusual ingredients and gets a surprisingly pleasant outcome, getting the attention he craved. However, soon Tom and Jerry must come up with a plan when the heavenly scent turns bad.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Tom and Butch both arrive to ask out Toodles, their competitive behavior prompts her to send them away to a charm school she recently attended. But how will they fare in the grueling etiquette courses taught by elegant cat instructors?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Things go awry when Cates orders Tom to clean and inspect the family automobile. Tom, Jerry and Tuffy end up taking the car into the countryside and doing their best to control it. As Tom reads and attempts to follow the instruction manual, Jerry and Tuffy help, but they also suffer many near-misses.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

However, all the dresses are very expensive – but he comes up with a plan. He can buy a dress, then return it after the event provided it still has the label attached. Can Mr Bean protect the dress without Irma realising what he’s doing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

Mrs Wicket does so well that Mr Bean lets her have a proper lesson in his beloved car – but Mrs Wicket gets carried away in the real car, and it’s a white-knuckle ride!

But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: he gang head out to a Day of the Dead festival. There, they learn the spirit of the old, legendary criminal, El Bandito, has returned to terrorize the locals. Fred becomes obsessed with solving the mystery and becoming a part of the great legend, himself.

In a medical book, a person whose leg is in a cast is being served dinner in front of a TV. Grizzy pretends to have a twisted ankle and shows the Lemmings the patient care illustrations. The imaginary invalid Grizzy is so convincing that the Lemmings fall for the trick. They think that the sooner Grizzy is healed, the sooner they will be able to throw him out of the cabin as planned.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: On the beach, the Lemmings have set up a mini funfair for tourists. Each attraction lets you to win tickets, which are then used to collect prizes from a vending machine. Grizzy, who is not very good at games of skill, steals the tickets collected by the Lemmings in order to obtain the jackpot. The Lemmings decide to create an attraction just for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that oysters can make pearls almost instantaneously: just put an object inside their shell and it’s automatically coated with mother-of-pearl The game of marbles that the Lemmings have invented with pearls is driving Grizzy crazy. He manages to catapult the Lemmings far away. But at the ocean bottom, they discover a giant oyster. All they need to create a giant-scale marble game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2

They look so pitiful that Grizzy doesn't have the heart to throw them into the void, even if they are extremely annoying when they try to snuggle up to him to keep warm. He decides to heal them: the quicker they get better, the quicker Grizzy will be able to get rid of them pitilessly.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a pack of icy mints that literally chill your breath. One blast from anyone who eats them freezes everything in sight. Grizzy does not particularly care for this frosty ambiance and tries to take their candy away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy can't believe it: he has just swallowed a spoonful of his favorite food, chocolate spread, and he hates it! How could that be possible? And yet, when he swiped the jar from the Lemmings, they seemed to be enjoying it immensely. A quick investigation reveals that the Lemmings added a dash of lemon juice to the jar to give the spread a sharper taste. And they intend to jazz up the rest of the stock as well!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1

There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in the library studying his family heritage. Someone brings to his attention Mr Bean’s resemblance to a certain Lord Bean. Mr Bean sets off to track down his ancestral home (a castle) in Scotland where he is welcomed with open arms. But owning a castle is not cheap. Can Mr Bean escape before he runs out of money and has there been a case of mistaken identity?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean and his beloved car find themselves in a crash for crash battle with his arch nemesis the Reliant Robin. It’s a contest to find out who can hold their nerve the longest. Does Mr Bean win? Is his car left unscathed? And more importantly do we find out who the driver of the Reliant Robin really is?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has got everything ready for Irma’s birthday; card cake candles but he just needs to get her some flowers. But nothing goes to plan as Mr Bean inadvertently causes a car crash involving a bride on her wedding day. There’s no time to lose as Mr Bean promises he’ll get the bride to the church on time. Irma is not a happy lady as Mr Bean is distracted by the task in hand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Nipping to the shops for a few provisions becomes a nightmare when a mile-long shopping list from his landlady and a clapped out trolley with a wonky wheel conspire to ruin his day. Subscribing to the theory that bigger is better, he constructs his own shopping trolley incorporating a petrol mower, pram wheels and an extra pair of hydraulic hands.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1

But the Baby Lemmings are using all these elements to make increasingly incredible domino courses! When Baby Raccoon discovers this, he just feels they've made a mess of the forest again, and decides to pick it up despite the Baby Lemmings' annoyance.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While eating breakfast, the Baby Lemmings discover a hot stone near a spring that enables them to cook their food. They find it incredible and decide to start cooking. Baby Owl, asleep nearby, is attracted by the smell and plunders their feast!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1

Meanwhile, the baby lemmings are discovering how to make kites out of leaves. When Baby Lynx sees them, she wants to catch them, and the baby lemmings have to be extra agile to dodge Baby Lynx's attacks.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Grim are trapped together in an observatory museum overnight.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs is overjoyed to find other rabbits living in the forest but getting their acceptance proves more difficult than he thought.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs discovers Bigfoot's fear of water and decides to teach him how to swim.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: After pillaging a monastery Yosemite Sam attempts to outwit an enlightened Bugs Bunny to receive the treasure of a lifetime.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang heads to the Velma's beloved authentic Renaissance Faire, where they must find a way to infiltrate the royal feast in order to stop an evil court jester from ending the king's reign, permanently, and closing the faire!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to do something romantic on Valentine’s Day for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. But while he is secretly delivering her valentines card Mr Bean finds out he has a love rival for Irma’s attention. Bean steps up his efforts and takes Irma on a ‘date’ to the Valentine’s Fair only to find his love rival is there too! But will the fortune-teller’s prediction be the ticket to a happy ending?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After Tyke digs up, Hammy, Spike's lucky bone, Spike reburies it right away because it's bad luck to remove it. Soon afterward, Tom gets a set of toy dog bones that do tricks, and he teases Spike and Tyke with them. When the whirly-bone buries itself and unearths Hammy for a second time, Spike recruits the other animals to help prevent the bad luck he expects.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: A ghost paints a flattering portrait of Tom, but Tom is stingy with his payment and the ghost casts a spell on the portrait. Strange things start happening as the portrait absorbs injuries and calories that should be affecting Tom. However, soon Jerry and Tuffy figure out what's going on and use it to their advantage.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Rick and Ginger are asked to dog-sit for a friend's French poodle, Sabrina, Tom is initially on his guard, but soon he's practically eating out of her hand. Next, Spike falls for Sabrina and does everything he can to impress her with how kind he is to Tom. How long will everyone's behavior be affected by Sabrina's presence?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange American Indian figurine with the power to switch the spirits of two living beings and finds himself imprisoned in the body of a caribou. He immediately tries to activate the reverse procedure, but the Lemmings steal the figurine in order to turn into a partridge and fly away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While salmon fishing on the riverbank, Grizzy hauls in an unusual catch: an old hand mirror straight out of a fairytale. Instead of showing the reflection of the person who holds it, the mirror shows an idealized vision of his surroundings. Whether it be Grizzy or the Lemmings, everyone sees the world of his dreams, and no one wants to share it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: In a casing that fell from a circus caravan, the Lemmings find a magic stick that can enchant objects and make them come alive. Grizzy is sure that a stick like that would save him a lot of work, the only problem is how to get it from the Lemmings, who have become sorcerer's apprentices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst trying to stop the Lemmings from playing with a crate of firework rockets, Grizzy is literally carried away with them when the largest specimen shoots off. When the entire crate of fireworks explodes with a boom, they are hurled out of the atmosphere and all the way to the moon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With their endless battles over the ranger's cabin which they do not want to share, Grizzy and the Lemmings end up blowing the cabin up. Amidst the debris, they discover a strange pack: an army tent with all the necessary equipment to recreate a home in nature. It's the chance to discover the joys of camping in the wild.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings encounter a white bear which has drifted all the way to them on a chunk of ice which is slowly melting. The bear makes a fabulous rodeo partner, he just needs enough ice to keep cool. Even a few ice cubes on his head are enough. The only obstacle to this beautiful friendship is Grizzy, who considers himself master of the fridge and thus of the cabin's ice production.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kid Kazoom and Multy have to enter an active volcano to retrieve a new Kazoom fragment.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Everyone is ecstatic when Bibi, Batgirl, and Robin capture Toyman and his Do-Over remote – except for Bibi, who failed to stick the landing on a big jump. Unwilling to accept her failure, Bibi uses Toyman’s Do-Over remote until she perfects her jump!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When Bam is sent to take on Prank, Redbird is forced to hang back because The Joker’s van is too dangerous! When Bam discovers that Redbird secretly tagged along, he’s upset… until Redbird bails him out of a tight spot.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After Jestah’s insults get the best of her, a short-tempered Bibi tries to not let the big-wheeled bully's words get to her so she can help Batgirl catch Harley.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Feeling neglected after being passed over on missions, Bam asks MOE to install experimental upgrades to curry Batman's favor. But, when Bam's new powers are stronger than he can control, Batman – and the mission – are suddenly in danger!

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Parth Peacock to build a puppet stage and puppets in India. They soon learn that Parth’s form of puppetry differs from their own and must correct everything in time for his big show.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: After a hot cocoa disaster, Santa Claus hires The Looney Builders to build him a new toyshop in time to save Christmas.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes a taxi to his local toyshop but a dodgy cabbie thinks he can take Mr Bean for a ride. After a mix up Mr Bean finds himself driving the taxi and starts to have fun couriering people to their destinations even giving an American tourist an extensive tour of London. But will the taxi driver find out what’s been going on and how much will Bean’s final fare be?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to impress Irma who is infatuated with the hunky deliveryman. Bean tries to improve his physique at the gym but has little success. Instead he opts for an inflatable muscle suit. Irma is indeed impressed and Bean’s plan seems to be working – until the suit gets punctured and Bean makes the mistake of re-inflating it with helium. As Bean floats off into the sky will Irma’s admiration be punctured?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom And Jerry take their chase to the skies. Kite-flying has never been this intense. Who will emerge as the ultimate master of strings?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy gleefully discovers that he can print images taken with the ranger's camera which is connected to a state-of-the-art printer. He decides to immortalize and frame himself, but when the time comes to print his portrait, there's no more paper in the printer. The Lemmings have thrown themselves heart and soul into the regressive pleasure of paper airplanes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: A van pulls up to the ranger's cabin to deliver a full crate of jars of chocolate spread. While Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a wrecking bar to open it, someone steals the crate. Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to carry out an investigation to find the trail of their treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Like usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter! The Lemmings have requisitioned the cabin for a party and barricaded themselves inside. Grizzy has no intention of waiting for an invitation to find a way to get in.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a bouncing ball. Grizzy realizes that if he wants to take a nap, he must first get rid of the magic beans.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano in the garage at any cost, for the Lemmings love using it to make a dissonant racket. But when he happens to notice that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of Für Elise he decides to learn the learn the piece like a real pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings inherit a crate that fell off a Canadian army convoy transporting ultra-secret material. The case inside the crate emits a sort of laser beam that divides objects into multiple miniaturized versions of themselves. What if the Lemmings had to deal with lots of mini-Grizzys rather than just one big one?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Near the supermarket, a machine hands out surprise eggs in exchange for a coin. Amongst the lots to be won, there is a super firework rocket that makes the Lemmings dream, and a piece of costume jewelry that Grizzy imagines himself giving to his lady-love.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: At the Ranger's home, Grizzy finds a high-tech gadget that enables you to learn anything at all sewing, origami, Kung Fu, etc... within only seconds thank to electrodes hooked to the brain. He can now become the perfect bear! But first, he first needs a program to learn how to get rid of the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: An old metal box found by chance in a recess of a cliff brings back childhood memories for Grizzy and the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: How can one peacefully watch a documentary on salmon fish, nice and comfy on the sofa, when the Lemmings are playing chemistry novices with a fun experiment box? By confiscating their equipment? Beware of side effects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy's TV remote control is stolen by a partridge who collects high-tech objects in his nest perched high up in a tree. This is a case of absolute urgency! Grizzy has no other choice but to requisition the Lemmings propulsion game to recover his possession. But try and make a Lemming understand that!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy has got it into his head to offer a butterfly to the she-bear he's in love with. But the Lemmings fight with him over the rare specimens he's spotted, for they want to play helicopter. The butterfly hunt is on!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered an addictive new game based on the astonishing bouncing properties of the ranger's new running shoes. Grizzy, who is trying to relax, confiscates the shoes and soon realizes they are far more comfortable than his thongs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy babysits for the she-bear he has a crush on, who has entrusted him with the care of her cub. There's no question of Grizzy tripping up, for he has no intention of taking any risks! But he hadn't reckoned on the Lemmings. Captivated by the baby's burps after meals, they dream of making it drink gallons of soda pop to make it do the Big One.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Unwilling to share the food both he and the Lemmings are wild about, Grizzy locks it up inside the ranger’s brand new and apparently burglar proof safe. He watches the Lemmings’ vain attempts to open the safe with amusement, until he realizes that the string around his neck with the key is far from indestructible.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

Meanwhile, Jodie's life without M.O.D.O.K. flourishes as one of her videos goes viral, launching her into internet fame.

programme.title: M.O.D.O.K. 1
programme.desc: Lou, feeling like M.O.D.O.K. is stifling his individuality ahead of his bar mitzvah, jumps into M.O.D.O.K.’s portal to Asgard. There, Lou is taken by a tribe of goblins known as Kobolds, but wins them over with his magic tricks and becomes their leader. He refuses to go back home with his dad, so M.O.D.O.K. takes control of an army of Asgardian warriors and wages war against his son. Eventually, M.O.D.O.K. and Lou strike a deal and use Lou's magic tricks to pacify the Kobolds. Meanwhile, the Super Adaptoid agrees to help young M.O.D.O.K.

programme.title: Solar Opposites 1
programme.desc: Korvo tries to get the family involved in repairing the spaceship, but they attend a birthday party instead, where he is inspired to become a magician. Using his computer system Aisha, Korvo creates a technologically advanced magic act; he goes viral and prepares for a Las Vegas show, which will culminate in him leaping through a black hole. Korvo ignores his family's warning that jealous magicians plan to kill him; the family save him from being shot, but he dies when the black hole trick goes awry. The grieving family agree to repair the ship in Korvo's memory, and he reappears, having faked his death to bring them closer together. Yumyulack adds a woman named Cherie to his shrunken collection.

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Andy metsikud seiklused
programme.desc: Andy ja Kipi metsikud seiklused viivad nad üle maailma veidrate ja imeliste loomade otsinguile.

programme.title: Hirmus ajalugu
programme.desc: See on energiline, üllatav ja tavapäratu kujutlus ajaloo kõige jubedamatest, kuid samas naljakamatest sündmustest. Muserdavatest maailmasõdadest ja kurvast keskajast võikate viikingite ning kihvtide kreeklasteni. Ajalugu pole kunagi olnud nii ulakas.

programme.title: Andy reisiseiklused
programme.desc: Andy, Jen ja Scout reisivad oma keskkonnasõbraliku masinaga mööda maailma ja avastavad looduse saladusi ning loomade uskumatut käitumist.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Meister igal alal
programme.desc: Kümme noorsportlast osalevad ülimal spordivõistlusel. Trikk on aga selles, et nad ei võistle oma spordialadel, vaid teiste võistlejate aladel. Võistluse lõpus enim punkte kogunud sportlane pälvib tiitli Meister igal alal.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Loomade jutud
programme.desc: Lõbus ja hariv saade loomadest nii looduses kui koduaias. Igas osas saame teada huvitavaid ja üllatavaid tõsiasju ning mis kõige toredam, loomad ise räägivad endist...

programme.title: Joonistame koos
programme.desc: Maailmakuulsate Marveli, Ämblikmehe ja Tähesõdade koomiksiraamatute kunstnik Will Sliney näitab, kuidas joonistada tegelasi maailma tuntumatest multikatest, nagu näiteks „Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks“, „Vali maja“, „Boss Beebi“, „Käpapatrull“ ja paljud teised.

programme.title: Andy veeseiklused
programme.desc: Andy naaseb vaimustavate veeseiklustega. Avasta temaga koos veekogusid üle kogu maakera ning kohtu delfiinide, vaalade ja muude hämmastavate loomadega.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed

Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Ponas kūdikis 2. Šeimos reikalai
programme.desc: Broliai Templetonai jau užaugo ir sukūrė savo gyvenimus. Timas dabar tikras šeimos vyras. Jis vedęs gražuolę Karolę ir augina dvi dukreles. Septynerių Tabita yra tikra protinguolė, o jaunėlė Tina – žavi naujagimė. Tedas tapo rizikos draudimo fondo generaliniu direktoriumi ir visas problemas sprendžia šlamančių dolerių kupiūromis. Timas ir Tedas nėra tokie artimi, kaip buvo vaikystėje, bet juos suvienija bendra misija. Pasirodo, mažoji Tina yra „Kūdikorpo“ agentė. Ji vykdo labai svarbią užduotį, tad paprašo tėčio ir dėdės pagalbos. Ar trijulei pavyks atskleisti tamsias paslaptis, slypinčias Tabitos mokykloje? Ar jiems pavyks sustabdyti mokyklos įkūrėjo Ervino Armstrongo kėslus?

programme.title: Briusterio milijonai
programme.desc: Nevykėlis beisbolo žaidėjas Briusteris netikėtai sužino, kad mirė jo giminaitis. Pasirodo, šis buvo turtuolis ir paliko Briusteriui visą savo kapitalą. Tačiau turčius buvo tikras keistuolis, todėl Briusteris, norėdamas užvaldyti milžiniškus pinigus, turi per 30 dienų išleisti 30 milijonų. Manote, lengva iššvaistyti tiek pinigų? Visai nelengva, ypač kai niekam nė žodeliu negali prasitarti, iš kur juos gavai ir kodėl taip išlaidauji...

programme.title: Trys muškietininkai: D'Artanjanas
programme.desc: metai. Prancūzija.Čarlzas D‘Artanjanas, energingas jaunas gaskonas, paliekamas mirti po to, kai bandė išgelbėti jauną merginą nuo pagrobimo. Atvykęs į Paryžių, jis visomis išgalėmis mėgina surasti savo užpuolikus. Tik jis dar nežino, kad šios paieškos nuves jį į tikrą karą su kardinolu Rišeljė ir ant kortos bus pastatyta visos Prancūzijos ateitis.Beprotiškai įsimylėjęs karalienės patikėtinę Konstanciją, D‘Artanjanas atsiduria realiame pavojuje, nes būtent ši aistra suveda jį su mirtina prieše: miledi de Winter.Padedamas trijų bebaimių muškietininkų – Ato, Porto bei Aramio – špaga ginkluotas D‘Artanjanas narsiai kovoja dėl meilės, teisybės ir šviesaus rytojaus.Visi už vieną ir vienas už visus!

programme.title: Kotrynos burtai
programme.desc: Jei savo virtuvėje jaučiatės labiau svečiais nei šeimininkais, jums į pagalbą atskubės Kotryna Starkienė! Šį sezoną įvairius sezoninius patiekalus iš savo pačios užsiaugintų gėrybių ji ruoš ne tik žiūrovams jau pažįstamoje sodyboje, bet pakvies apsilankyti ir didmiesčio virtuvėje. Čia žiūrovų lauks gardūs, tačiau tuo pat metu ir lengvi, laiką taupyti padedantys receptai. Žiūrovų laukia patarimai, kaip pasiruošti maisto visai savaitei, ką įdėti vaikams į priešpiečių dėžutes ar kaip greitai ir nebrangiai paruošti patiekalus draugų vakarienei.
